source.title: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists with sodium–glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitors in heart failure: a meta-analysis
source.source_type: systematic review and fixed-effect meta-analysis of RCT subgroup data

consistency_findings.detail: Supplementary Figure 12A reports placebo RR 1.77 (95% CI 1.51–2.08) for MRA use versus no MRA, whereas the structured graphical abstract prints 1.77 (1.51–2.03). The atom uses the supplementary forest-plot value and the discrepancy is not repaired.
The article text/graphical abstract reports interaction P <0.001, while the supplementary forest plot is more extreme (<0.00001). These are retained as different source representations.
The article text/graphical abstract reports P-interaction = 0.051, while Supplementary Figure 12B visually rounds to 0.05.

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema is oriented to primary literature and has no explicit systematic-review/meta-analysis result object, certainty-of-evidence field, or interaction-test field. Pooled estimates are represented as quantitative_result/subgroup_result/adverse_event atoms tagged meta_analysis/pooled_estimate; trial-level observations reported by the review are not represented as if Banerjee et al. generated those primary-study data.
